name: BAGEL
description: Open ROS 1 and ROS 2 bags (.mcap, .db3, .bag), PX4 logs, point clouds and Gaussian splats in your browser. No install, no upload. Open source Foxglove alternative.

paragraphs: Explore ROS1 & ROS2 bag files in your browser. No installation required.
BAGEL in 25 seconds. The robot recording is the r2bhallway sequence from the NVIDIA r2b dataset 2023 (CC BY 4.0). The Gaussian splat is "Knock Community Hall" by scbenoit (CC BY 4.0).
If BAGEL saves you a ROS install, a ⭐ helps other robotics folks find it.
features: A condensed feature list is below. Detailed version-by-version release notes (with the design rationale behind every feature) live in FEATURES.md.

ImageViewer: sensormsgs/Image (rgb8 / bgr8 / rgba8 / mono8 / mono16) and CompressedImage (jpeg / png) with lazy single-message reads. Foxglove equivalents (foxglove.RawImage, foxglove.CompressedImage) supported via JSON…

ThreeDScene (Three.js): PointCloud2, LaserScan, MarkerArray (all twelve primitives: CUBE / SPHERE / CYLINDER / ARROW / LINESTRIP / LINELIST / CUBELIST / SPHERELIST / POINTS / TEXTVIEWFACING / MESHRESOURCE / TRIANGLELIST…

whatItDoes.text: Explore ROS1 & ROS2 bag files in your browser. No installation required.

requirements.text: BAGEL is a fully static web application that lets you explore ROS bag files (.mcap, .db3, .bag), PX4 flight logs (.ulg), standalone point cloud files (.pcd, .ply), and 3D Gaussian Splat scenes (.ply, .splat, .ksplat) entirely in your browser needing no server, no installation, no account.
